waypoints.name: Blue Lake Trailhead
waypoints.note: Blue Lake Trail #314 trailhead on SR-20; shared approach for Liberty Bell and South Early Winters Spire (NW Forest Pass required).
waypoints.directions: Drive SR-20 to the signed Blue Lake Trailhead on the south side of the highway, about 1 mile west of Washington Pass. A Northwest Forest Pass is required to park.

waypoints.name: Liberty Bell Mountain
waypoints.note: First of the five summits: the traverse tops out Liberty Bell by the Beckey Route, then carries on south over Concord Tower, Lexington Tower and North Early Winters Spire to finish on South Early Winters Spire.
waypoints.directions: Follow the Blue Lake Trail about 1.5 miles to the climbers' junction just past a small stream, marked by a large cairn, then climb the path up slabs, talus and heather into the gully below the Liberty Bell-Concord notch. Keep climber's left low in the gully, cross right higher up, and take the left fork a couple of hundred feet below the notch to the Beckey Route start; four short pitches lead to the summit.
